answer: The quartz is the seed, the spiral is the soil, and the quill is the season: a farm cannot harvest what it never planted. The bench does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same. A farm falls at the first real check when the check is Certified lace maker ground stitch file with guild hall seal, which demands 4-year apprenticeship, 165 supervised lace panels, masterpiece assessment, guild dues from every applicant. Every alias pays its own way: 53 POA locked, 12 minutes spent, and 458 aliases means 24274 POA gone.
